name: Acıbadem University
ranking: Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2026: 1501+

It specialises in health sciences and medicine, working in close partnership with Acıbadem's nationwide network of hospitals, and also offers programmes in engineering, business and the social sciences with English-language instruction.

name: Altinbas University
ranking: THE World University Rankings 2026: 1501+ (41st in Türkiye)
description: Altınbaş University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 2008 (formerly İstanbul Kemerburgaz University). It offers English- and Turkish-medium programmes across medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, engineering, law, business and the social sciences, and hosts a large international student community.
address: Mahmutbey Mahallesi, Dilmenler Caddesi No:26, 34217 Bağcılar, İstanbul, Türkiye
housing: Student housing is operated by the university's Dormitory Directorate. The residences provide study and drawing rooms, computer equipment, television rooms, a restaurant, a game room, a fitness centre, a music room and food and beverage vending machines. Applications and current fees are handled directly by the Dormitory Directorate.

name: Bahcesehir Istanbul University
ranking: THE World University Rankings 2026: 801–1000 (9th in Türkiye)
description: Bahçeşehir University (BAU) is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 1998. Located on the Bosphorus and part of the international BAU Global network, it offers English-medium programmes across medicine, engineering, law, business, communication, architecture and the arts.
address: Çırağan Caddesi, Osmanpaşa Mektebi Sokak No: 4-6, 34353 Beşiktaş, İstanbul, Türkiye
housing: BAU's city campuses do not have on-campus dormitories (apart from the Future Campus), so the International Office places students in affiliated private residences such as REPUBLIKA Residence, roughly 10-15 minutes from the main Beşiktaş campus, and in nearby private dormitories including women's halls in Beşiktaş and Akaretler. Many students instead rent private or shared flats in surrounding neighbourhoods, with the university providing guidance on listings and contracts. Dormitory rooms typically cost around USD 700-950 per month with utilities included, while a private flat is usually USD 500-750 plus about USD 50 of utilities.

name: Beykent University
description: Beykent University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 1997. It offers a broad range of undergraduate and graduate programmes across engineering, business, law, communication, fine arts and the health and social sciences, with multiple campuses across the city.
address: Ayazaga Mahallesi, Hadim Koruyolu Cd. No:19, Sariyer, Istanbul, Turkiye
housing: The university runs the Ayazaga Student Dormitory, a 6,000 square metre residence with 120 rooms located within walking distance of the Ayazaga-Maslak campus. Rooms include private bathrooms, air conditioning, a mini-refrigerator, satellite television, wardrobe and study desk with internet access. Shared facilities cover a television lounge, fitness centre, study rooms, recreation areas and laundry. Services include daily breakfast during the academic year, weekday room cleaning, 24-hour hot water via central heating and free satellite broadcasts; applicants may choose their own roommates and resident managers assist with settling in.

name: Beykoz University
description: Beykoz University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 2016 and rooted in the Beykoz Logistics vocational school. It specialises in logistics, business, engineering, art and design, and the social sciences, with an applied, sector-focused approach.
address: Orhan Veli Kanık Caddesi No: 114, Kavacık, Beykoz, Istanbul, Türkiye
housing: Beykoz University does not operate its own residence halls; instead it arranges accommodation for students through agreements with private dormitories located in the Beykoz district, close to the Kavacık campuses. Students may also rent privately in the surrounding Kavacık and Beykoz neighbourhoods, which are well served by bus links to both the European and Asian sides of Istanbul. The international office assists incoming students with finding contracted dormitory places.

name: Biruni University
ranking: Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2026: 1201–1500
description: Biruni University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 2014. Named after the polymath Al-Biruni, it focuses on health and life sciences — medicine, dentistry, pharmacy and allied health — alongside engineering and the social sciences.
address: Merkezefendi Mah., 75. Sk. No: 1-13, 34015 Zeytinburnu, İstanbul, Türkiye
housing: Biruni University operates gender-separated dormitories in the city centre with rooms for one to six students. Facilities include breakfast service, laundry, high-speed internet, a shuttle service, 24-hour security, study rooms, shared kitchens, lounges, gym access, basketball and volleyball courts, an infirmary, a reception desk and climate control. Biruni students receive a 15 per cent discount.

name: Doğuş University
description: Doğuş University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 1997. It offers English- and Turkish-medium undergraduate and graduate programmes across engineering, economics and administrative sciences, law, arts and design, and the social sciences.
address: Dudullu OSB Mah. Nato Yolu Cad. No: 265/1, Ümraniye, Istanbul, Türkiye

name: Fatih Sultan Mehmet Vakıf University
description: Fatih Sultan Mehmet Vakıf University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 2010 and rooted in historic Ottoman charitable foundations. It offers programmes across engineering, architecture and design, Islamic sciences, humanities and the social sciences, with particular strengths in culture, restoration and the arts.
address: Rektörlük - Yenikapı Mevlevihanesi, Merkezefendi Mahallesi, Mevlevihane Caddesi No: 25, Zeytinburnu, İstanbul, Türkiye
housing: The university's International Student Office supports incoming students with accommodation guidance and orientation from application through arrival and settling in. FSMVÜ does not publish details of its own dormitories on its website, so housing is arranged case by case through that office, with students generally placed in private or state-run residences near the relevant campus.

name: Fenerbahce University
description: Fenerbahçe University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 2016 and affiliated with the Fenerbahçe sports club. It offers programmes across engineering, health sciences, sports sciences, business, communication and the arts.
address: Atatürk Mah. Ataşehir Bulvarı, Metropol İstanbul, 34758 Ataşehir, İstanbul, Türkiye
housing: Fenerbahçe University arranges separate dormitory accommodation for male and female students through partner residences near the Ataşehir campus. The halls include breakfast service, heating, internet access, laundry facilities and gym use in their standard packages. Placement and booking are handled by the university's accommodation contact within the International Office, and many students also rent private flats in the surrounding Ataşehir and Kadıköy districts.

name: Haliç University
description: Haliç University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 1998. It offers programmes across medicine and health sciences, engineering, business, fine arts, conservatory and the social sciences, with campuses along the Golden Horn (Haliç).
address: 5. Levent Mah., 15 Temmuz Sehitler Cad. No:14/12, 34060 Eyupsultan, Istanbul, Turkiye
housing: Halic University offers dedicated student housing marketed as Halic Dorms and publishes accommodation guidance for international students through its international office, which also assists with residence-permit appointments. Room types, capacity and fees are not published on the public website.

name: Istanbul Arel University
description: Istanbul Arel University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 2007. It offers programmes across engineering, health sciences, business, communication, fine arts and the social sciences, with a focus on applied, industry-linked education.
address: Türkoba Mahallesi, Erguvan Sokak No:26, 34537 Tepekent, Büyükçekmece, İstanbul, Türkiye
housing: The Arel student village sits close to the Kemal Gözükara campus in Tepekent, Büyükçekmece, and is laid out as independent villa residences rather than a single dormitory block. Residents have a free shuttle service on scheduled ring routes, cafeteria and dining hall, 24-hour security and access to the university health centre, a semi-Olympic swimming pool, fitness centre, basketball and volleyball courts and table tennis areas.

name: Istanbul Atlas University
description: Istanbul Atlas University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 2018. With a strong focus on health sciences, it offers programmes across medicine, dentistry, pharmacy and allied health, alongside engineering, aviation and the social sciences.
address: Hamidiye Mahallesi, Anadolu Caddesi No:40, 34408 Kağıthane, İstanbul, Türkiye

name: Istanbul Aydin University
description: Istanbul Aydın University (IAU) is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 2007. One of the city’s largest universities, it offers a wide range of English- and Turkish-medium programmes across medicine, engineering, business, communication, fine arts and the health and social sciences.
address: Beşyol Mah., İnönü Cd. No:38, 34295 Küçükçekmece, İstanbul, Türkiye
housing: Istanbul Aydın University runs a women's dormitory close to the Florya campus and has agreements with a number of private dormitories in the surrounding districts, which international students can book through the university's student affairs and Erasmus offices. Many students share flats instead, most commonly in Sefaköy, Florya, Bahçelievler, Bakırköy, Ataköy or Avcılar, all within easy commuting distance of the campus. The International Student Affairs office assists new arrivals with finding and arranging housing before and after registration.

name: Istanbul Bilgi University
description: Istanbul Bilgi University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 1996. Part of Global University Systems, it is known for the social sciences, law, communication, business and the arts, with a vibrant campus on the Golden Horn (santralistanbul).
address: Eski Silahtarağa Elektrik Santralı, Kazım Karabekir Cad. No: 2/13, 34060 Eyüpsultan, İstanbul

name: Istanbul Galata University
description: Istanbul Galata University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 2019. Located in the historic Galata district, it offers programmes across health sciences, engineering, business, economics and the social sciences.
address: Evliya Çelebi Mahallesi, Meşrutiyet Caddesi No: 62, Tepebaşı, Beyoğlu, İstanbul

name: Istanbul Gelisim University
description: Istanbul Gelişim University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 2011. One of the city’s largest and most international universities, it offers English- and Turkish-medium programmes across health sciences, engineering and architecture, applied sciences, economics and the fine arts.
address: Cihangir Mah. Sehit Jandarma Komando Er Hakan Oner Sk. No:1, Avcilar, Istanbul, Turkiye
housing: Istanbul Gelisim University does not run its own dormitories. Instead, the International Relations Office maintains a list of more than fifteen private dormitories and student residences in the districts around the Avcılar campus and helps incoming students arrange a place. Shared flats with Turkish students are also commonly arranged through the office and student networks, and prices are set directly by each private provider.

name: Istanbul Kent University
description: Istanbul Kent University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 2016. It offers programmes across health sciences, engineering, dentistry, economics, fine arts and the social sciences in the heart of the city.
address: Merkez Mah., Cendere Cad. No:24, 34406 Kagithane, Istanbul, Turkiye

name: Istanbul Kultur University
ranking: QS Europe: 601+; QS Emerging Europe and Central Asia: 401-450 (year not stated)
description: Istanbul Kültür University (IKU) is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 1997. It offers programmes across engineering, architecture, law, economics and administrative sciences, arts and design, and the sciences.
address: Ataköy Kampüsü, E5 Karayolu Üzeri, Bakırköy, 34158 İstanbul, Türkiye
housing: The university runs the İKÜ Girls Dormitory with a capacity of 211 places in two- to four-person rooms, each with a private bathroom and 24-hour hot water, air conditioning, wireless internet, wardrobes, desks and a mini fridge. Shared facilities include lounges, study rooms, free laundry and ironing rooms, a cafeteria serving breakfast and dinner, and 24/7 security with card access. Prices are provided by the International Office on request.

name: Istanbul Nisantasi University
ranking: THE Impact Rankings 2025: SDG 7 201–300; SDG 3 601–800; no overall world rank

address: NeoTech Campus, Maslak Mah. Tasyoncasi Sok. No:1V, Sariyer, Istanbul, Turkiye

name: Istanbul Okan University
ranking: THE World University Rankings (latest): 1501+; THE Impact Rankings: 601–800
description: Istanbul Okan University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 1999. It offers programmes across medicine, dentistry, engineering, business, law and the health and social sciences, with a strong international focus and multilingual instruction.
address: Istanbul Okan University Tuzla Campus, 34959 Akfirat, Tuzla, Istanbul, Turkiye
housing: Five dormitory buildings on the Tuzla campus accommodate around 1,500 students in separate male and female blocks. Rooms range from single to four-person occupancy, each with private bathroom and refrigerator, and annual fees are published with and without meal plans. Free study rooms, laundry, prayer room, wired and wireless internet and 24-hour hot water are included, with round-the-clock staff, security and on-site medical services. Residents also use the campus fitness centre, swimming pool, squash and other sports facilities plus four dining halls. Students at the city-centre Sisli/Mecidiyekoy site are directed to nearby private residences.

name: Istanbul Rumeli University
description: Istanbul Rumeli University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 2015. It offers career-focused programmes across health sciences, engineering and architecture, applied sciences, and economics and administrative sciences.

name: Istanbul Sabahattin Zaim University
description: Istanbul Sabahattin Zaim University (İZÜ) is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 2010. It offers programmes across engineering and natural sciences, health sciences, business, education, Islamic sciences and the social sciences.
address: Halkalı Caddesi No: 281, Halkalı, Küçükçekmece, 34303 Istanbul, Türkiye
housing: The university refers international students to guesthouse accommodation, which it describes as offering a warm and friendly living environment; specific capacities and prices are not published on the international pages.

name: Istanbul Yeni Yüzyıl University
description: Istanbul Yeni Yüzyıl University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 2009. With a strong emphasis on health sciences, it offers programmes across medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, health sciences, engineering and the social sciences.
address: Maltepe Mahallesi, Yılanlı Ayazma Caddesi No: 26, 34010 Cevizlibağ, Zeytinburnu, Istanbul, Türkiye
housing: The university does not run its own halls of residence but has agreements with private student dormitories in Istanbul that give its students discounted rates. Partner residences include the Novu women's dormitory, which offers cash and card payment discounts plus early-registration reductions, and the Kampüs Otuz Dört women's and men's dormitories in Beşyol, Küçükçekmece. The international office publishes contact details for each dormitory so students can arrange housing directly.

name: Istinye University
ranking: 31st in Türkiye (URAP 2025-2026); 16th in Türkiye in THE World University Rankings 2026
description: İstinye University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 2015 and affiliated with the MLP Care / Medical Park hospital group. It has a strong focus on health sciences, offering programmes across medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, engineering, business and the social sciences.
address: Ayazağa Mah. Azerbaycan Cad. (Vadi İstanbul 4A) Blok No: 3H, 34396 Sarıyer, İstanbul
housing: İstinye University does not operate its own halls of residence; instead it maintains agreements with a set of private student dormitories across Istanbul that offer discounted rates to ISU students, including Konforist (Eyüpsultan), Republika and Academia in Maslak/Sarıyer, Santral in Eyüpsultan and Dormhouse in Beyoğlu. Options cover single through multi-share rooms, with separate male and female buildings and shuttle or metro access to the Vadi and Topkapı campuses. Many international students also rent shared flats in the surrounding Sarıyer, Maslak and Kağıthane districts.

name: Işık University
description: Işık University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 1996 and rooted in the historic Feyziye Schools Foundation (1885). It offers English-medium programmes across engineering, business, economics, communication, fine arts and the sciences.
address: Isik University Sile Campus, Mesrutiyet Mahallesi, Universite Sokak No: 2, 34980 Sile, Istanbul, Turkiye
housing: Student dormitories are located on the Sile campus and consist of 16 buildings with a combined capacity of 1,455 beds, mostly in three-person rooms with sea or forest views, plus four two-person rooms adapted for students with disabilities. Rooms include a desk, bookshelf, wardrobe, study chair and fridge, and shared facilities cover 24-hour study rooms, laundries, kitchens, central heating, high-speed wired and wireless internet, cleaning services and round-the-clock security. Published 2025-26 annual rates run from about USD 2,050 for a triple room to about USD 6,600 for a single room, with optional meal plans.

name: Kadir Has University
description: Kadir Has University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 1997. Housed in a landmark restored tobacco factory on the Golden Horn, it is known for its programmes in communication, international relations, engineering, business, law and the arts.
address: Cibali Mah. Kadir Has Cad. 34083 Fatih, Istanbul, Turkiye
housing: The university owns a 69-bed women's dormitory directly behind the Cibali Campus, offering accessible, double and triple rooms with private shower and toilet, fridge, desk and high-speed internet, plus a study hall, lounge, kitchen and laundry. Housing scholarships can cover dormitory costs for eligible female students, while the White Dove scholarship covers places for eligible male students. The university also holds discount agreements with private dormitories near campus, and state-run KYK dormitories across Istanbul are available at low monthly rates including breakfast.

name: Medipol University
ranking: Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2026: 801-1000
description: Istanbul Medipol University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 2009. With a strong focus on health sciences and its large Medipol Mega hospital complex, it offers programmes across medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, health sciences, engineering, law and the social sciences.
address: Kavacik Mah. Ekinciler Cad. No: 19, Beykoz, Istanbul, Turkiye
housing: The university runs two on-campus dormitories in Kavacik with a combined capacity of about 2,400 students: a women's dormitory on the South Campus with 1,797 places in quadruple rooms and a men's dormitory in Block D of the North Campus with 543 places in triple rooms and 13 single rooms. Rooms have a study desk and bookshelf, private bathroom with shower and WC, mini refrigerator, shoe cabinet and free Wi-Fi, and the women's dormitory adds lockable wardrobes, a hobby kitchen and a fitness centre. Shared facilities include a dining hall serving three meals a day (paid separately), a cafeteria and laundry rooms with ironing; bedding is provided and cleaned periodically. Students based at the Halic campus generally use the many private dormitories in the surrounding university district.

name: Ozyegin University
description: Özyeğin University (ÖzÜ) is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 2007. English-medium and entrepreneurship-focused, it offers programmes across engineering, business, aviation, hospitality, law and the social sciences on its campus in the Çekmeköy hills.
address: Özyeğin University, Çekmeköy Campus, Nişantepe Mahallesi, Orman Sokak, 34794 Çekmeköy, İstanbul, Türkiye
housing: Özyeğin University runs its own dormitory complex on the Çekmeköy campus with a total capacity of roughly 2,700 residents, offering rooms on a nine-month academic-year basis. The university's published cost-of-living page quotes accommodation for the nine-month period at between 83,600 and 320,000 TL (about USD 1,850–7,100) depending on room type. Because housing, classrooms, dining halls and the free sports centre are all on the same site, most resident students need no daily commute.

name: Sabanci University
description: Sabancı University is a leading private, non-profit research university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 1994. English-medium and highly selective, it is consistently ranked among the country’s best universities, known for its interdisciplinary approach across engineering and natural sciences, management, and arts and social sciences.

name: Uskudar University
ranking: THE World University Rankings 2026: 1501+ (13th among Turkish foundation universities)
description: Üsküdar University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 2011. Specialising in behavioural health, it is known for its programmes in psychology, neuroscience, health sciences and related fields, alongside engineering, communication and the social sciences.
address: Altunizade Mahallesi, Üniversite Sokağı No: 14, 34662 Üsküdar, İstanbul
housing: Üsküdar University does not place students in a single central hall of residence; instead the International Office collects each newly registered student's preferences and budget through a form and then recommends suitable options. Its published list covers a range of licensed private and institutional dormitories in the Üsküdar, Kadıköy and Beşiktaş districts, including separate women's and men's dormitories, and the university also runs the Nakkaştepe female student guesthouse. Students who prefer to rent independently are pointed to established Turkish property portals, and accommodation questions are handled at accommodation@uskudar.edu.tr.

name: Yeditepe University
ranking: 51st in Türkiye (U.S. News Best Global Universities, as listed by the university)
description: Yeditepe University is a private foundation university in Istanbul, Türkiye, established in 1996 by the Istanbul Education and Culture Foundation (İSTEK). One of Türkiye’s largest private universities, it offers English-medium programs across medicine, dentistry, engineering, law, and social sciences on its modern Kayışdağı campus.
address: İnönü Mah. Kayışdağı Cad. No: 326A, 26 Ağustos Yerleşimi, 34755 Ataşehir, İstanbul
housing: Two residence halls on the 26 Ağustos campus accommodate 3,637 students, so the great majority of resident students live within walking distance of teaching buildings, libraries and sports facilities.

name: Ankara Bilim University
description: Ankara Bilim University is a private foundation university in Ankara, Türkiye, established in 2017. It focuses on technology, engineering, architecture, business and the social sciences, with an emphasis on industry collaboration and applied, career-oriented education in the capital.
address: Maltepe Mah. Şehit Gönenç Cd. No:5, Çankaya, Ankara, Türkiye

name: Ankara Medipol University
description: Ankara Medipol University is a private foundation university in Ankara, Türkiye, established in 2018 as part of the Medipol education group. It offers programmes in medicine, dentistry, health sciences, engineering, law, business and the social sciences, with a strong focus on health and applied sciences in the capital.
address: Hacı Bayram Mah. Talatpaşa Bulvarı No: 4/1, Altındağ, Ankara
housing: The university provides separate on-campus dormitories for male and female students at its main campus. The women's dormitory offers single, double and triple rooms, while the men's dormitory adds VIP rooms alongside single, double and triple options. Current rates are not published online and are quoted on request by the International Students Office; the university estimates a dormitory place at around EUR 125 per month.

name: Atilim University
description: Atılım University is a private foundation university in Ankara, Türkiye, established in 1996. It offers English-medium undergraduate and graduate programmes across engineering, medicine, business, law, architecture and the social sciences, and is known for its strong research output and accredited engineering programmes.
address: Kızılcaşar Mahallesi, İncek, Ankara, Türkiye
housing: Atılım University states that it is still building residence capacity on its İncek campus and currently refers students to private dormitories in central Ankara that are licensed by the Ministry of National Education. The most frequently recommended are the Emre male student dormitory and the Nazlı female student dormitory in Çankaya, which quoted 2024-2025 rates of roughly USD 6,000-7,500 per person per year depending on room occupancy, including breakfast and dinner, laundry, internet, 24-hour security and a shuttle to campus. The university stresses that it has no commercial affiliation with these dormitories, and many students instead share rented flats in Çankaya, Gölbaşı or İncek.

name: Lokman Hekim University
description: Lokman Hekim University is a private foundation university in Ankara, Türkiye, established in 2017. Named after the legendary physician Lokman Hekim, it focuses on health sciences, offering programmes across medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, nursing and allied health, supported by its affiliated hospitals.

name: OSTIM Technical University
ranking: THE Impact Rankings 2026: 1001–1500; not in THE World University Rankings 2026
description: OSTIM Technical University is a private foundation university in Ankara, Türkiye, established in 2017 by the OSTIM industrial zone. It focuses on technology and engineering, offering industry-integrated programmes across engineering, architecture and applied sciences.
address: OSTIM, 100. Yil Bulvari No: 55/F, 06374 Yenimahalle, Ankara, Turkiye
housing: The university does not run its own halls of residence but partners with a number of private dormitories close to the campus, offering options for both male and female students. Because the campus is immediately next to the OSTİM metro station, most partner dormitories are within a 15-20 minute commute along the metro line. Dormitory fees vary according to the services provided and the number of students per room, and the International Relations Directorate advises applicants on choosing and booking a place.

name: TED University
ranking: THE Impact Rankings 2026: 801–1000; not in THE World University Rankings 2026
description: TED University (TEDU) is a private non-profit university in Ankara, Türkiye, founded in 2009 by the Turkish Education Association (TED). It offers English-medium, liberal-arts-based education with an interdisciplinary curriculum and a mandatory co-op work experience program.
address: Ziya Gökalp Caddesi No: 48, 06420 Kolej, Çankaya, Ankara, Türkiye
housing: TED University offers two off-campus dormitories run by its own dormitory management: a men's dormitory in Maltepe housing 93 students and a women's dormitory in the Mustafa Kemal / Bilkent district with two blocks accommodating 392 students. Rooms include study desks, wardrobes, refrigerators and en-suite bathrooms, with specially designed accessible rooms for students with disabilities. Shared study, rest and social areas are provided, and students who prefer private housing must supply a notarised rental contract for their residence permit.

name: Izmir Tinaztepe University
description: İzmir Tınaztepe University is a private foundation university in İzmir, on Türkiye’s Aegean coast, established in 2019. Rooted in the Tınaztepe hospital group, it focuses on health sciences, offering programmes in medicine, dentistry, pharmacy and allied health.

name: Yaşar University
description: Yaşar University is a private foundation university in İzmir, Türkiye, established in 2001 by the Selçuk Yaşar Sports and Education Foundation. Located in central Bornova, it offers English-medium programs in business, engineering, communication, and the arts, and is known for its strong international partnerships and Erasmus mobility.
address: Selcuk Yasar Kampusu, Universite Caddesi No:37-39, Agacli Yol, 35100 Bornova, Izmir, Turkiye
housing: Yasar University runs its own student dormitory in Bornova at 367/2 Sokak No:9/2, Kazim Dirik Mahallesi, a short distance from the Selcuk Yasar Campus. It provides separate accommodation for male and female students with shared common areas, breakfast and lunch service, security and a resident support team, and is managed through the university's YURTSIS system with separate online application forms for each section. Room rates and capacity are not published on the public site.

name: Alanya University
description: Alanya University (formerly Alanya HEP University) is a private foundation university in Alanya, Antalya Province, Türkiye, established in 2011. Located on Türkiye’s Mediterranean coast, it offers English- and Turkish-medium undergraduate and graduate programmes in fields such as engineering, business, law, health sciences and tourism.

name: Antalya Bilim University
description: Antalya Bilim University is a private foundation university in Antalya, Türkiye, established in 2010 (formerly Antalya International University). It offers English-medium undergraduate and graduate programmes in tourism, business, engineering, law and the social sciences on Türkiye’s Mediterranean coast.
address: Çıplaklı Mah., Akdeniz Bulvarı No:290 A, Döşemealtı, Antalya, Türkiye
housing: The university provides on-campus and off-campus dormitories, including an on-campus female residence. Rooms have wireless internet, an individual study desk and reading lamp for each student and 24/7 hot water. Safety is covered by security cameras, round-the-clock security staff, fire detection and suppression equipment in every room and building-wide fire alarms. Shared amenities include a movie theatre, table tennis, a football stadium, basketball and tennis courts, a fitness centre and paid laundry. Room types and pricing are arranged through the Directorate of Health, Culture and Sports.

name: Avrasya University
description: Avrasya University is a private foundation university in Trabzon, on Türkiye’s Black Sea coast, established in 2013. It offers undergraduate and graduate programmes across health sciences, engineering, economics and administrative sciences, and the social sciences.
